facts.fact: Minya was chosen as the pilot for the first digital governorate headquarters, and the minister of communications expected its headquarters to be linked electronically to the governorate's districts (marakiz) and local units during 2024, before the rest of local administration follows; said on 15 January 2024 as an expectation, not as done.
facts.system: project to automate local administration and governorate headquarters

facts.fact: The project to automate local administration and governorate headquarters is carried out by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology with the Ministry of Local Development and the governors, within the state's institutional digital transformation project, as the minister said on 15 January 2024.
facts.system: project to automate local administration and governorate headquarters

facts.fact: The minister's statement of 15 January 2024 on the project to automate local administration names no budget or funder for it.
facts.system: project to automate local administration and governorate headquarters
